body:
I had been drinking whiskey throughout the night and I was quite drunk.  I decided to take my prescription of 450mg bupropion, and 50mg of Zoloft.  I remembered I had bought what was supposedly 'xanax' from a stranger. It turns out that it was actually Benzatropine which is an anticholinergic used for parkinsons disease.  I took at least 5 pills and was playing guitar. I slowly began to realize how messed up I really was, I couldn't play the guitar whatsoever and my eyesight began to get blurry I could see fine at a distance but I couldn't read.  I decided to go smoke a cigarette and go to bed. I felt relatively normal still.  When I was sleeping I was dreaming that I had just eaten a lot of mushrooms and that I was hallucinating.  I woke up and I tried to find the nonexistent bag of mushrooms.  It was about 3am and I stumbled out of bed deliriously, my balance was thrown off.  I stumbled down the hall to the bathroom and realized that I was tripping really hard.  It really reminded me of a mushroom trip, I realized it wasn't because of mushrooms but instead because of the Benzatropine.  Eventually I went back to sleep because I was extremely delirious and hallucinating.  In the morning when I woke up I was still tripping a little bit and I was starting to come down.  The walls and carpet were still all melding into each other.  I realized that my vision was still really messed up and it scared me so much, I thought that I destroyed my eye sight and that I would need glasses.  I had a severe sore throat.  The blurred vision didn't go away and revert back to my normal eyesight for two or three days, that part really scared me. I also had a sore throat for two days.
Overall it wasn't worth it at all to take this medication thinking it'll get me high like xanax. It's for sure not xanax.  The hallucinations were really cool, I usually have anxiety when tripping on anything but acid but this didn't give me anxiety until I started to come down and deal with the side effects.  The sore throat was absolutely terrible.  The extreme blurred vision was really scary.  I couldn't text anyone or even use the internet or read.  I basically just tried to act like I was normal for the two to three days that I couldn't see. Thankfully now my eyesight is back to normal.
